description: This file contains functions for loading Parquet datasets into a Superset example database, including serialization of numpy arrays, handling complex data types, and creating dataset loader functions.

methods.name: serialize_numpy_arrays
methods.description: Converts numpy arrays and scalars to JSON-serializable formats.
